title: Time Is the
<g>Wrong Question</g>
subtitle: The clock counts every hour the same. We don't have to.

lines: before I'd asked a single question.

cards.title: What was it for?
cards.body: Friends, news, rest... “for nothing” counts too.

cards.title: Did I choose it?
cards.body: A choice turns an hour into time I spent, not time I gave.

cards.title: What did it crowd out?
cards.body: The walk where I saw more screen than sea.
